translations./garage/brief: Return from the signal tower to the calibration pad with the full tracked assembly. Long contact patches cross rough ground well, but narrow S-bends need room for scrub and corner sweep.
translations./prediction/heading: What Limits a Tracked Long Haul?
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction: will a slow tracked chassis stay stable or begin to oscillate over the long route?
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Gentle control + high-grip material can finish
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Correct. The tracked assembly, gentle policy, and high-grip material complete the narrow S-shaped route in about 155 s.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Lower speed alone cannot remove track scrub or the effect of traction material.
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: Changing material alone cannot remove the corner sweep of long tracks in a tight bend.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-3: Long-haul cruise stable. Tracks holding pace.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The same long route, completed steadily on tracks. Slow dynamics can shine.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find which badge was lost. Tracked motion punishes an uneven pace.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Tracked mission failed: time limit exceeded
